card.name: Visually inspect before use
card.fires_on: The word "inspect" right after "Visually" in preparation instructions for injectable products. Also fires weakly on "over" in "60 and over" and on "ly" in "Elderly".

modes.label: Visually inspect
modes.description: The verb "inspect" after "Visually" in instructions to check a solution for particles or discoloration.
